# Krishna Infosys

> Krishna Infosys is an ELV (Extra Low Voltage) systems integration and turnkey solutions company based in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. Established in 2001, the company provides system design, supply, installation, commissioning and maintenance services. The company has completed 2,200+ projects and has 25+ years of industry experience.

## Company information

- Website: https://www.krishnainfosys.com
- Operational office: #15 & 16, 1st Floor, Swastik House, Opp. Muktjivan Photo Lab, Above Income Tax Under Bridge, Stadium Cross Road, Navrangpura, Ahmedabad – 380009, Gujarat, India
- Phone: +91 79 4030 4848
- WhatsApp: +91 99794 85888
- Email: info@krishnainfosys.com
- Business hours: Monday–Friday, 10:30 AM–6:30 PM; Saturday, 10:30 AM–5:30 PM; Sunday closed
- Primary service area: Ahmedabad, Gandhinagar and Gujarat
- Project delivery: India-wide

## Services

- [CCTV and access control systems](https://www.krishnainfosys.com/solutions/security-access): CCTV surveillance, IP cameras, access control, intrusion alarms, boom barriers and video door phones.
- [Communication systems](https://www.krishnainfosys.com/solutions/communication): EPABX, intercom, video conferencing and public address systems.
- [Audio-visual systems](https://www.krishnainfosys.com/solutions/audio-visual): Audio-visual solutions for meeting rooms, boardrooms, auditoriums and displays.
- [Networking and data](https://www.krishnainfosys.com/solutions/networking-data): Structured cabling, LAN and Wi-Fi infrastructure.
- [Automation and safety](https://www.krishnainfosys.com/solutions/automation-safety): Fire detection and alarm systems, building automation and home automation.
- [AMC and support](https://www.krishnainfosys.com/amc-support): Annual maintenance and support for CCTV, fire alarm and other ELV systems.
